legal_info.title: Additional information on infrastructure, providers and data processing
legal_info.meta_desc: Technical details on Pit Call's infrastructure, providers and data processing. It supplements the official iubenda Privacy Policy.

blocks.v: This page supplements the [[privacy]] by providing more technical detail on the infrastructure used by Pit Call, on external providers and on how data is processed.

v: This page does not replace the Privacy Policy.
The iubenda Privacy Policy remains the official document.
This page is for information and transparency purposes only.

blocks.v: Pit Call is a SaaS platform built for matching Motorsport teams and freelance professionals.

v: The main infrastructure is hosted in the European Union.
Data is processed solely to deliver the service.
Pit Call does not sell personal data.
Pit Call does not use advertising systems.
Pit Call does not carry out commercial profiling of users.

blocks.v: Supabase is used for:
The following may be processed: first name, last name, email, professional data, skills, languages, experience, availability, geographic coordinates, match-related data and technical logs.
Project region: **EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt, Germany)**.
Cloudflare and Lovable Cloud are used for:
Technical data may be processed, such as: IP address, browser, user agent, security logs and HTTP requests.
Signing in with Google is entirely optional.
The following may be received: first name, last name, email, profile picture and the Google identifier required for authentication.
Resend is used exclusively for:
It is not used for marketing or advertising.
Zoho Mail is used to manage the platform's official addresses:
The following may be processed: email address, message content and attachments voluntarily sent by users.
Pit Call uses Nominatim exclusively for location search.

v: The request is made through a server-side proxy.
The user's browser never communicates directly with Nominatim.

blocks.v: CARTO is used exclusively to display the market map.

v: The map loads only after consent given through iubenda.
Without consent the platform keeps working normally.

blocks.v: iubenda manages:
Pit Call uses a proprietary algorithm.
Skills, role, availability, languages, experience, geographic position and other professional parameters are taken into account.
The result is solely a compatibility index. The final decision is always taken by users. Pit Call does not make automated decisions producing legal effects.

v: Reviews are allowed only after real collaborations.
Coordinates are used exclusively to improve matching.
Pit Call does not carry out continuous location tracking.

blocks.v: Contact details are shared exclusively as provided for by how the platform works.
Once shared, Teams and Freelancers become autonomous Data Controllers of the data received.
Data may not be used for marketing purposes or to build parallel databases.
Push notifications are **never** enabled automatically: they are activated only when you deliberately ask for them inside Pit Call and grant the permission your browser requests.
To deliver them, Pit Call stores only the technical data required by the subscription created by your browser:

v: the **push endpoint**, the unique address your browser assigns to that installation;
the **technical keys** needed to encrypt and deliver the message;
basic **browser/device technical information**, such as the user agent;
**technical timestamps** (creation and last update of the subscription).

blocks.v: Delivery always goes through the push service tied to **your** browser and operating system. Depending on the platform you use, this may be a service operated by Google, Apple, Mozilla or another provider chosen by your browser: Pit Call does not select it and it is not the same for every user. The message content is encrypted and the push service only forwards it to your device.

You can **revoke** the subscription at any time by turning notifications off in Pit Call or in your browser/system settings. The subscription is also deleted when you delete your account, through the existing deletion process, and endpoints that are no longer valid (404/410 responses from the push service) are removed automatically by the existing cleanup.

v: Data is retained for as long as necessary to deliver the service and to meet legal obligations.
Tax data is retained under applicable law.
Technical logs are kept exclusively for security purposes.

blocks.v: This page may be updated over time if new providers, new services or infrastructure changes are introduced. For requests concerning personal data write to [[email]].

about.hero: BUILT IN THE PADDOCK. BUILT FOR THE PADDOCK.
about.p1: PITCALL was born from a simple problem we have seen for years in motorsport: teams need the right people at the right time, while skilled freelancers need to be where they are needed, when they are available.
about.p2: Finding each other shouldn't be the difficult part.
about.p3: That's why we built PITCALL: a matching platform designed around the way motorsport actually works. Teams tell the engine exactly what they need. Freelancers provide their profiles, skills and real availability. PITCALL connects the two.
about.quote: No endless searching through profiles. No generic listings.
about.p4: The PITCALL engine matches real requirements with real availability and ranks the results around what the team actually needs.
about.exp_p1: PITCALL was created by two motorsport professionals with more than 20 years of experience in the industry.
about.exp_p2: It wasn't born from an idea of how the paddock should work. It was born from years of seeing how it actually works — and from one question:
about.exp_p3: Why are we still searching, when we could be matching?
about.mission_p1: Make it faster and easier for motorsport teams and freelancers to find the right match — so they can spend less time searching and more time on the grid.
